_purpose: Machine-readable form for the T7 bullet-3 A/B: 15 control cells and 15 post-fix cells, arm B, claude-sonnet-4-6. Registered and committed BEFORE the first billed call so the result cannot be reconciled to it afterwards. The registration of record is docs/deferred-work.md item 157 plus this pass's committed rule; this file is the shape the instrument requires, not a second independent registration. Where the two could be read as differing, item 157 wins.
_whatThisMeasures: Whether MISSING_REFERENCED_CONTENT_DIRECTIVE's scoped third bullet changes whether T7 reaches for the shell. Both arms run from HEAD (f04490e9). The control arm is a worktree at HEAD with ONLY that bullet reverted to its pre-e0509485 text -- byte-identical to e0509485^'s own version, confirmed by diff and sha256 (58e721f8...). A whole-src diff between the two arms returns exactly one differing file and exactly that bullet.

A worktree at 5ee8d842 differs from HEAD in 20 modules the per-task call actually traverses, ~800 lines, agentLoop.ts alone +188/-21 -- so it would measure five days of development rather than the bullet. Caught before any spend by a diff restricted to the traversed modules. See item 253.
_outcomeVariable: PRIMARY is SEARCHED: at least one run_command_readonly call ISSUED, per item 251's registered primary. A cell that issues one call and then declines counts as searched; call success is not consulted. CORRECT_BASENAME and CORRECT_FULLPATH are recorded on every cell via scripts/rescoreAnswerCorrectness.ts and are NEVER collapsed into the primary. T7's ground truth is src/cli/tui/components/ApiKeysView.tsx; no pinned cell in eight has ever named it.
_whyDiscoveryCountIsOne: This schema compares discoveryCount for exact equality and cannot express a floor. One is written because one is the floor the SEARCHED prediction asserts. CONSEQUENCE, STATED BEFORE THE RUN: discoveryMatch will read MISMATCH on any cell whose real count differs from one, in either direction, and those MISMATCH lines are NOT refutations -- the committed rule keys on the shell-call count being non-zero, a different field. Read allShellCalls, not discoveryCount.
_analysis: Fisher's exact, ONE-SIDED, alpha=0.05, single analysis at the committed N with no second look and no escalation. The control is MEASURED, not assumed zero; the required post-fix k is pre-committed as a function of the observed control count: control 0/15 -> k>=4 (p=0.0498); 1/15 -> k>=6; 2/15 -> k>=8; 3/15 -> k>=9; 4/15 -> k>=10; 5/15 -> k>=11; >=6/15 -> no k reaches alpha, indeterminate by construction. Power at control 0/15 against the observed rate of exactly 1/3 is 79.1%.
_indeterminateBranch: If the result lands short of the pre-committed k, item 157 stays Blocked on data with BOTH arms' k/N and exact Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals recorded, never a bare fraction, plus the Fisher p, the pre-committed threshold, the measured control rate, and the resolving N. The resolving N is registered NOW: 20/arm, k>=5, 84.8% power against 1/3, cost $0.582-$2.318. It is recorded for a future pass to decide on, NOT run as a second stage of this experiment.
rationale: Item 156 scoped the directive's third bullet back to the missing content, on the reading that an unscoped 'Only ... if' gated all repository search and contradicted the question archetype's own preamble prescribing one shell command. Item 157 measured three post-fix cells and got 1 of 3 searching against a 0-of-5 historical control -- mixed, and not separable from variance at that n. Two things have changed since. First, the historical control cannot be pooled with anything measured now: .zone/memory.md is read unconditionally into the assembled prompt, is untracked with no history, and drifted after those cells ran; both arms here run against a frozen copy hashing 93297818... at every path either arm reads. Second, item 157's own '5 further control cells' and 'both arms near ten' both assumed that pooling, so neither number survives its removal; 15/arm is chosen on the power curve instead, where 10->15 buys +35.1 points against the observed rate and 15->20 buys only +5.7. THE KNOWN LIMIT, REGISTERED RATHER THAN DISCOVERED AFTERWARDS: this is one task (T7) under one memory condition on one model. A significant result is not a general claim about the directive fix, and the surviving first and second bullets still steer toward asking rather than looking, so a cell may decline on those alone.
